name: gclipy
description:
Clipboard history and snippets menu, inspired by the macOS app Clipy.

- Text and image history, newest first, with numbered items (press 1-9, 0 to paste)
- Pinned items that survive clearing, rearranged with Ctrl+Up/Down
- Snippet folders edited as JSON in your text editor
- Opens at the pointer with Shift+Super+V and pastes into the focused window
- Skips content marked secret by password managers and excluded apps

History is stored locally in ~/.local/share/gclipy and never leaves your computer.
